premises.text: Connected vehicles face real cyber-attack risk that can seize steering, braking, and acceleration
premises.evidence_span: suddenly your car is hacked. Critical control functions, such as steering, braking, and acceleration, is out of your hands

premises.text: Secure IoT software protects connected vehicles via a multi-layered stack including encryption, authentication, key management, firewall, OTA updates, and big-data modules, with patents
premises.evidence_span: Our core solution is Secure IoT. This is a software-based solution for protecting connected vehicles from hacker attacks

premises.text: Cybersecurity-as-a-service charges about $10 per vehicle per month with continuous updates for fleet owners
premises.evidence_span: We charge $10 per vehicle per month to protect them from outside attacks

premises.text: Revenue-sharing go-to-market runs through automotive OEMs deploying security and service providers selling subscriptions to fleet owners
premises.evidence_span: Trillium develops automotive cybersecurity solutions, an automotive OEM deploys our security in their vehicles, and a customer service provider

value.text: Stopping car hacking so next-generation mobility can be deployed on secure onboard systems

causal_links.evidence_span: protecting connected vehicles from hacker attacks
cybersecurity as a service offering that we offer to fleet owners

notes: Feature cascade of Secure IoT modules folded into one mechanism premise; patents as IP detail (§4.1.1/7). DEF CON and partner-project traction excluded. Autonomy/EV/rideshare framing treated as value rationale not separate premises. Price kept with SaaS offer (§4.1.3). Singleton D1/D2 retained.
